requests.request: Film yourself wrapping your hands before a session. Close-up on the wrap going around the knuckles, wrist, between fingers. No talking — just the sound of fabric. End on you clenching the fist and looking up.
requests.storyAngle: The ritual before the fight. Every boxer knows this moment — the quiet before the work starts. It's not a tutorial, it's a meditation.
requests.verbalHook: Text overlay: 'The fight starts before the first punch'
requests.visualHook: Freeze frame of wrapped fist clenching, knuckles tight, with gym out of focus behind
requests.editingNotes: Slow-mo the final fist clench. Black and white filter. No music, just fabric and breathing sounds. CapCut film grain overlay.
requests.example: Boxing hand wrap ASMR videos get millions of views — the ritual resonates

requests.request: During pad work, get someone to film from behind the student. We see your pads in foreground, student throwing combos. After a good combo, catch the moment you nod or give a quick word. The correction moment is the content.
requests.storyAngle: Why I never say 'good job' until I mean it. The nod means something because it's earned.
requests.verbalHook: Text overlay: 'I don't give compliments. I give corrections. The nod means you earned it.'
requests.visualHook: Mid-action — student throwing a cross, pads up, Paul's face half-visible behind the pad showing concentration
requests.editingNotes: Speed ramp: normal speed combos, slow-mo on the correction moment. Zoom cut on Paul's face when he nods. Text overlay on the 'why' at the end.
requests.example: Coach reaction videos perform well — the feedback moment is the hook

requests.request: Empty gym before anyone arrives. Walk through slowly with phone. Bags hanging still. Light coming through windows. Then cut to the same angle 30 mins later — class in full swing, bags moving, energy.
requests.storyAngle: Every day this room transforms. 6pm it's silent. 6:30pm it's alive. That's what a boxing gym does to a space.
requests.verbalHook: Text overlay: '6:00pm vs 6:30pm — same room, different energy'
requests.visualHook: Split screen or before/after — empty gym vs packed class, same angle
requests.editingNotes: Transition effect between empty and full. Time-lapse the arrival if possible. CapCut smooth transition. Upbeat track kicks in on the 'after' side.
requests.example: Before/after transformation reels consistently viral across fitness
